summary: Broker acknowledgement attachment is serialized with fill accounting and preserves established identity, terminal status and cumulative cashflow; known real acknowledgement followed by local persistence failure retains original-client lookup-only recovery and truthful reconciliation-required exhaustion.
changes: SELECT FOR UPDATE and populate_existing before ACK attachment serialize with existing stream/recovery writers; different persisted broker identity is rejected.
Real Alpaca dispatcher shape contains alpaca_response; original broker/client/symbol/side/requested quantity and fill/status fields validated by shared pure validate_order_snapshot.

First full/partial/terminal-partial real ACK applies cumulative cashflow through unchanged apply_order_fill_snapshot and commits summary+Execution+PositionLot/RealizedTrade+ORDER_FILLED audit together.
Stale lower cumulative ACK is ignored; duplicate is idempotent; same-quantity price correction stays explicit rather than rewriting lots.
Top-level mock/shadow compatibility retained for first ACK; delayed lower fills/partial-state demotions are blocked, and synthetic mode metadata cannot relabel an existing real broker UUID.
Only _update_order_status, _process_order_submitted and _process_event ASTs changed in this worker; all other worker source AST remains equivalent to base.
Known real broker acknowledgement is recorded before local accounting awaits; local persistence exception returns existing original-client submission_ambiguous/reconciliation_required contract.

Successful real broker result also latches the existing lookup-only marker before marking an outbox event sent; a sent-commit failure cannot lose that classification. No retry policy, adapter, submission or cancellation protocol changes.

validation.red_scope: Five desired-invariant failures: two actual nested real-dispatch cases (late new/zero ACK after filled; first filled ACK without accounted fills), plus three direct updater/top-level variants. The latter are not misrepresented as real dispatcher top-level fill fields.
validation.test_environment: Parent isolated runner; fresh scratch HOME/brain, synthetic SQLite, explicit async/timeout plugins, all network denied, installed writes/private runtime reads denied.

freeze.basis: Recorded candidate nonsecret environment; no actual runtime observation.

validation.wrapper_red_scope: Three actual dispatcher/wrapper/updater cases fail before extension because local accounting or sent-commit failure does not persist the original-client ambiguity marker; final run proves GET-only recovery or truthful reconciliation-required DLQ.

postgres_ack.scope: Seven actual disposable PostgreSQL cases plus five DSN safety cases; includes direct ACK-versus-stream row-lock contention. Wrapper recovery tests use SQLite and mocked HTTP.

validation.counts_not_additive: The earlier, final, peer and PostgreSQL suites overlap; do not sum them as unique platform coverage.

limits: Bounded PostgreSQL lock/rollback cases are not general stress or distributed exactly-once certification.
A process crash/cancellation or unavailable durable persistence before the ambiguity marker commits remains a broker/local crash window; no atomic broker/database guarantee is claimed.
No old history rewrite, live broker/order/API call, installed runtime change, credential/model access, active cutoff/reset, or strategy change.
Full safety artifact pack/CI/docs/commit/PR are parent-owned and remain separate gates.

superseded_component_report.note: Immutable earlier updater-only report retained; its wrapper and PostgreSQL limitations are superseded only by the specific later evidence bound here.
